g.text: • Enforces SI symbols (g, kg, mL, L).

text.tspan: 2. Edible Oils: 30°C density correction (Mass = Vol × Density).
3. Snacks: Rule 6(11) Unit Sale Price (USP) mandatory per g/mL.
4. Cosmetics: Net weight at packing vs retail loss limits.
5. Beverages: Cylindrical PDP (0.4 × H × C). Blown +0.5mm font.
6. General FMCG: Full 7 declarations under Rule 6(1).

g.text: Hands-Free Speech AI Assistant & System Core
Audio Mic ➔ Web Speech API ➔ Hands-Free Camera Trigger
"Audit Batch 42 Fortune Oil" triggers automated multi-panel capture.
"Violation: Net quantity font size 1.2mm violates Schedule II (min 2.0mm)."
initSystemTelemetry(): Monitors API latency, WebSocket heartbeat, storage quotas, and IndexedDB sync queues.
Zero-Signal Offline Ledger & Bidirectional Synchronization Architecture
Inspection records and high-res package photos are stored
directly in IndexedDB (paarakhmetric_db). Officer gets instant
feedback & print-ready PDF memo with zero network reliance.
initSystemTelemetry() pings endpoints. Once 4G/WiFi is restored,
automated queue dispatcher uploads records using exponential retry
Audits commit to SQLite + FTS5 full-text search and replicate
across district collectors via Firestore listeners in <100ms.
Enables statewide heatmap clustering & enforcement radar.
Statutory Penalty Recovery Ledger & Legal Enforcement Pipeline
Compounding fee up to ₹25,000 per Director
violation details in state official gazette.
Imprisonment up to 1 year or fine or both
automatically attached to each seizure record
for direct submission to CJM Magistrate Court.
